parsed.note_claim: The note claims that 8 U.S.C. § 1254a, Subsection (b)(5)(A) states there is no judicial review of the Attorney General's determination regarding designation, termination, or extension of a foreign state.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There is no judicial review of any determination of the Attorney General with respect to the designation, or termination or extension of a designation, of a foreign state under this subsection.
parsed.reason: The provided text of 8 U.S.C. § 1254a explicitly contains the exact language quoted in the note under subsection (b)(5)(A).
